ns2:course.label: Graduate Jazz Trombone
ns2:course.description: Instruction at the graduate level in jazz trombone normally associated with the jazz idiom. 2 to 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. May be repeated in separate terms to a maximum of 20 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Graduate standing in music, or successful completion of a qualifying audition for the appropriate jazz faculty.
